recommendation: Direct a single bounded repair pass over 23-license.qmd and its twin sentence in 00-front-matter.qmd, executed strictly within sealed rulings r-001, r-002 and r-003. (1) On the designation: re-point every hand-typed chapter reference to the printed numbering the shipped book uses, so that the spell bullet's cited pair becomes the printed spell chapters, the bestiary bullet's number becomes the printed stat-block chapter, the parenthetical file token becomes the printed opening-fiction chapter, and the front-matter pointer becomes the printed licence chapter. Re-scope the two range statements deliberately rather than by digit swap, deciding on the record which chapters the grant is to include. Reserve spell names on a clause of their own, so the reservation does not depend on the misdirected carve-out surviving. (2) On the declarations: extend the Product Identity reservation list additively with one explicit item claiming the withheld name category, stated in the chapter's own terms; do not rewrite the reproduced licence body and do not change the layout. (3) On attributions: do not treat the unlisted typefaces or the vendored package as a breached duty; confine the repair to the section lead-in, which must either name the families actually set or drop its promise of a font inventory, and make any statement about what the repositories hold match the tree as it is. The chapter is not publishable until items 1 and 2 land; item 3 is a wording repair. Hand the whole pass to the author as one chartered edit, and do not re-open the cleared axes.
rationale: The run produced ten findings over two rounds and left three topics contested. On t-01, the hand-typed chapter references in this file and its front-matter twin were written against a numbering the book no longer prints; the refute side was argued three times and grew stronger, ending with a second-round re-derivation of the whole source-to-print map at confidence 0.88 that extended the count to four unresolvable references while expressly confirming nothing in the ledger was overturned. No support position contested the numbering defect in the final round, and the single support finding cleared only the enumeration axis, which r-001 preserves as a standing condition. That unrebutted mismatch, and the concrete exposure of individually named spell cards under a misdirected carve-out, is why t-01 resolves as a live designation defect requiring correction in the printed numbering, with the two range statements re-scoped by decision rather than by digit swap. On t-02, two independent round-one derivations agreed that the release grant withholds a name category the reservation list never claims, that the chapter pairs its other carve-outs with reservations (making this an omission rather than a policy), and that the withheld material is populated rather than hypothetical; neither was answered in the final round, and the sole support position confined itself to the render dimension and re-filed nothing here. That leaves the gap standing unrebutted, so t-02 resolves as an incomplete reservation list to be closed additively, without touching the reproduced licence body or the confirmed-clean rendering. On t-03, the attributions finding rested on two premises, that the book ships the typefaces it embeds and that the omitted components carry a duty the section fails; both were attacked in round two on the state of the source tree, and no answering finding was filed, so both premises lose and the attributions finding is rejected as a duty breach. What survives is the part the attacking side itself conceded and that needs no legal opinion: the lead-in advertises a font inventory that no family name satisfies. The ruling therefore carries that defect forward while rejecting the claim, and the synthesis carries it with it rather than dropping it alongside the rejected framing. All three topics were decided inside the sealed rulings; the cleared axes (enumeration content, licence-body completeness, render and layout, and the attribution-duty question) are recorded as settled and are not reopened.

resolved.outcome: Designation defect confirmed. Every hand-typed chapter reference in the licence chapter and its front-matter twin must be re-pointed to the printed numbering the shipped book uses, the two range statements must be re-scoped deliberately rather than digit-swapped, and the reservation of spell names must be made to stand on a clause of its own. The cleared enumeration axis stands and no rewrite of the recital's content is required.

Reservation list confirmed incomplete against its own grant. It must be extended by one explicit item claiming the withheld name category, stated in the chapter's own terms and additive in form; the reproduced licence body is left as it stands and no layout or render change is required. The licence reproduction's completeness and the chapter's rendering are recorded as cleared.

No attribution duty is breached by the unlisted typefaces or the vendored package, and that claim is rejected. The repair is confined to the Third-Party Attributions lead-in, which must either name the typefaces it advertises or drop the claim to inventory fonts, and to making any statement about what the repositories hold match the tree as it is.

dissent.position: Cleared on the enumeration axis: every mechanic the OGC bullet names is still live in the shipped book and every mechanic it omits still sits inside the same grant, so the recital contains no retired rule and owes no addition. The twelve named systems verify against their owning chapters, and the unnamed ones (Grit, the Wound Table, Kits, Challenge, Boons and Banes, Fate) are already reached by the range sentence. The recital reads as drafting staleness, not a designation gap, and nothing at line 76 needs rewriting for content; the live fault there is its range bound and citation set, already in the ledger.

Judged on the built artifact, folios 379-386 show no layout defect, so this ballot supports on the render and convention dimension only and re-files nothing from the designation, attribution or spell-name findings. Per-folio fill is 71.5, 97.3, 98.1, 31.7, 34.8, 51.2, 16.8 and 27.6 percent; no folio is content-free; the five section heads open their pages in printed order and take the same level-2 form as the sibling chapter; the reproduction reaches every numbered section and lettered definition and closes on its three-line notice block with no clipped tail; the contact line sets in full with a resolving link annotation. One measured number belongs to a known book-wide front-matter counter family and is reported rather than filed.

Both premises of the round-one attributions finding fail against the tree. The vendored package carries its own tracked notice and provenance files, so its notice condition is met where copies of that software exist; the built book is a document produced with the package, not a copy of it. The tree holds no font binaries and no fonts directory, and the design layer instructs the builder to install the faces system-wide, so nothing redistributes typeface software and no font licence text was ever owed in the document; two reported families appear in no declared stack and entered as glyph fallback, inflating the measured omission. What survives is a wording tidy: the lead-in advertises fonts and no family name is printed, and the source repository the section points to is public. Net position is that no attribution duty is breached and the section is a scope choice plus one word of tidying.
